title: F1: Max Verstappen posts 75th career win at Las Vegas Grand Prix

blocks.text: Red Bull driver Max Verstappen roared to a superb victory at the Las Vegas Grand Prix on Saturday, holding his nerve in a thrilling 50-lap battle to claim the 75th win of his career. Verstappen dug deep to fend off Mercedes’ newly crowned world champion Kimi Antonelli and teammate George Russell in a race that saw a jaw-dropping 35 lead changes. McLaren’s Lando Norris took second place while Oscar Piastri finished third at the end of a hectic final few laps which saw Russell strike a wall before Antonelli faded down the stretch.
